### What changed

- **One App for everyday use and development.** Switch between release and development modes in Startup & Connection. Existing settings and data stay in their original locations; a failed switch restores the previous mode. Settings also include links to the product website and GitHub.
- **Desktop windows that move with your work.** Move the desktop window between Spaces in Mission Control while keeping its always-on-top preference. The launcher indicator follows the window's confirmed location. Development mode also closes and restores the installed App's edge panels correctly, preventing disconnected panels from lingering on another display.
- **A quieter Grok Bot workspace.** Responsive layouts make room for more Bots. Synchronized blinking and a single avatar badge show activity and status; progress, follow-up, and stop actions appear on hover or keyboard focus. Recent messages open from one shared entry.
- **Model presets and speed readings that stay useful.** Fast and standard presets can share a name without an unnecessary number. The latest visible-reply speed stays available for the current model and Fast setting across chats, with the current phase in parentheses, until a new reading arrives.
- **More complete controls.** Configure single-click, double-click, and right-click actions separately. New Chat and Dots switches now apply across features and display positions.
- **Interactive product demonstrations.** The product tour uses the actual interface components with sample data, expands model and Bot demonstrations, and lets the eyes follow the pointer after the opening animation without interrupting replay or scrolling.

### 更新内容

- **日常使用与开发共用一个 App。** 在「启动与连接」中切换正式／开发模式，原有配置和数据保留原位，切换失败恢复原模式。设置页新增宣传页和 GitHub 跳转图标。
- **桌面窗口随工作切换。** 可在调度中心将桌面窗口拖到其他桌面，同时保留置顶偏好；入口强调点跟随窗口实际位置。开发模式正确关闭、恢复安装版贴边面板，避免副屏残留断连窗口。
- **更安静的 Grok Bot 工作台。** 自适应排列容纳更多 Bot，双眼同步眨眼，头像和单个徽章展示状态；鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时显示进度、追问和停止，最近消息从统一入口按需查看。
- **更实用的模型预设与测速。** Fast 与普通预设可使用同名，不再多加重复编号；按当前模型和 Fast 状态保留最近一次可见回复速度，切换聊天仍可查看，括号显示当前阶段，测到新速度后更新。
- **更完整的操作设置。** 单击、双击和右键分别配置；新聊天与 Dots 的开关扩展到各功能和显示位置。
- **可交互的产品演示。** 介绍页用真实界面组件和示例数据展示功能，丰富模型与 Bot 演示；开场动画结束后双眼跟随鼠标，同时保留点击重播和滚动触发。
